note: CI scope policy (issue #1944 Batch 4, item I31). Scope=structure means the nightly job validates the classification tree only: the checkout ships configs/parameters.json, so its updated_at can never be inside max-age and enforcing freshness in CI produced a verdict that carried no information. Freshness must be checked where the file is actually refreshed (production host): atlas-validate --path=configs/parameters.json --max-age=48h --format=json. Findings listed in accepted are reported as observations; anything else fails the run.
